messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the modular cohesion audit RFC — I ran the coupling script across runtime traces and found a few cross-cutting deps we should pay down.
maria: can you paste the report link?
alex: https://rwd.infra/reports/cohesion/257123. Highlights:\n``\n- 8 high coupling edges from session-mesh -> policy-plane
- 12 hotpath dependencies: router -> enrichment
- 3 places where KV cache ownership is ambiguous
```\nsam: ouch. is that prod traces or static analysis?
alex: prod traces (30d window). static analysis catches similar but noisier edges.
rachel: proposal: run a focused 2-week paydown sprint. start with the session-mesh -> policy-plane edges — they look like clean facades to extract.
alex: agree. minimal migration plan:
1) add a small facade in session-mesh that surfaces a limited API
2) change writes to policy-plane to async/queued with optional sync fallback
3) add integration harness + canary on dedicated
maria: if we go async we need clear SLA guardrails. any consumers expect sync semantics today?
sam: only audits and our rate-limiter read sync. we can backfill via event-log + a short migration window. i'll own the migration scripts.
rachel: another flag: KV cache ownership is contested between enrichment and session-mesh. avoid moving state until we have fast rollback hooks.
alex: rolling plan: canary in dedicated us-east first, feature-flag gate. fallback route to old path if latency/error spikes.
maria: console question — can we correlate token-level traces for these calls? need trace hooks to validate impact on tail latency.
alex: yes, we'll add X-RWD-Trace header and wire it into per-route dashboards.
devops-bot: deploy started: canary /session-mesh-facade v1 -> dedicated-us-east-1 :rocket:
sam: rough ETA for PRs?
alex: PRs opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/432 (facade + async queue)
maria: i'll add evals in Redwood Optimize to watch quality regressions if batching/ordering changes.
rachel: timeline: sprint starts Mon, 10 working days, check-ins Wed/Fri. ownership: alex (lead), sam (migration), maria (quality/telemetry), rachel (coord).
alex: locking that in. tagging owners: @sam @maria @rachel
sam: ack. i'll draft the migration runbook under /docs/arch and add rollback steps.
alex: please call out any hidden syncs (webhooks, admin tools) early — those bite hardest.
maria: noted. :thumbsup:
devops-bot: canary health checks passed in us-east-1, latency +2ms, errors 0.1% — monitor window 30m
sam: good signal, watch for kv-miss spikes on router->enrichment path.
rachel: will monitor and post updates to the board. moving this to planning board.
